kjv: the just shall live by his faith
mine: the righteous shall live by his faithfulness
note: emunah is steadfastness/fidelity (the righteous person's loyal endurance while awaiting the vision); KJV's "faith" follows Paul's use (Rom 1:17, Gal 3:11), which reads it as trust or belief, a theologically pivotal shift.

kjv: to him that ladeth himself with thick clay
note: avtit is a hapax from avot "pledge" (taking goods in pawn), fitting the debtors of 2:7; KJV divided it as av tit "thick mud".
